tests.title: HMRC Tax Check Awareness — Mock Test 1

questions.question: Since April 2022, before renewing your TfL PHV licence you must complete a:
questions.explanation: An HMRC tax check is part of the licence renewal process.

questions.question: The HMRC tax check confirms you are:
options: Registered for tax on your licensed activity
questions.explanation: HMRC verifies that you are appropriately registered for tax.

questions.question: After completing the tax check you receive a:
questions.explanation: The 9-character code is given to TfL with your renewal.

questions.question: How long is a tax check code valid for?
questions.explanation: Tax check codes are valid for 120 days.

questions.question: If you fail to complete the tax check, TfL may:
questions.explanation: Without the code, TfL cannot legally renew.

questions.question: PHV drivers' earnings are normally taxed as:
questions.explanation: Most PHV drivers are self-employed and submit Self Assessment.

questions.question: Records of trips and earnings should be kept for at least:
questions.explanation: HMRC requires self-employed records to be retained for at least 5 years after the submission deadline.

questions.question: You can complete the HMRC tax check via:
options: Your online HMRC account or by phone
questions.explanation: It is done through your HMRC online account or via the helpline.
